{
  "findings": [
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_110",
      "title": "PostgreSQL pgAudit is not enabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The instance does not enable cloudsql.enable_pgaudit, limiting database-level audit visibility for security investigations."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_52",
      "title": "PostgreSQL connection logging is not enabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The instance does not explicitly enable log_connections, reducing visibility into successful and attempted database connections."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_53",
      "title": "PostgreSQL disconnection logging is not enabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The instance does not enable log_disconnections, making it harder to reconstruct database sessions during investigations."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_108",
      "title": "PostgreSQL hostname logging is not enabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The instance does not enable log_hostname, so database logs may lack useful client hostname context."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_54",
      "title": "PostgreSQL lock-wait logging is disabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The log_lock_waits flag is explicitly set to off, preventing logging of lock waits that can indicate availability or abuse-related issues."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_111",
      "title": "PostgreSQL statement logging is not enabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "No log_statement flag is configured, reducing audit visibility into security-relevant schema and role changes."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV2_GCP_13",
      "title": "PostgreSQL statement duration logging is not enabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The instance does not enable log_duration, limiting the diagnostic and audit information recorded for executed statements."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_14",
      "title": "Cloud SQL backups are disabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "The backup configuration explicitly disables backups, increasing the risk of unrecoverable data loss."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_6",
      "title": "Cloud SQL does not require encrypted client connections",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "HIGH",
      "explanation": "require_ssl is explicitly false, allowing database clients to connect without transport encryption."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_60",
      "title": "Cloud SQL has a public IPv4 address",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "HIGH",
      "explanation": "ipv4_enabled is true, assigning the database a public IP and unnecessarily increasing its network exposure."
    },
    {
      "check_id": "CKV_GCP_62",
      "title": "Cloud SQL deletion protection is disabled",
      "resource": "google_sql_database_instance.metadata_database",
      "severity": "MEDIUM",
      "explanation": "Deletion protection is explicitly disabled, increasing the risk of accidental or unauthorized destruction of the database instance."
    }
  ],
